Question 3

Which expression gives all of the zeros of y=3cos⁡(x+45∘)? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=45∘
b
x=90∘+n⋅360∘
c
x=45∘+n⋅180∘
d
x=n⋅180∘
e
x=−45∘+n⋅180∘
